svg.title: Massachusetts heating oil by census tract
svg.desc: Share of occupied homes heating with oil in 1594 census tracts. Statewide 22.4% of 2,785,042 homes; 624,510 heat with oil. A static fallback for the interactive map; the table view carries the same numbers as text.
svg.text: Massachusetts · 22.4% of 2,785,042 occupied homes heat with oil · ACS B25040
